LESSON: LENGTH

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Measurement
Topic 2.1: Length
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 14

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Length, part of Measurement in Grade 6 MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: Why do we measure distances in day-to-day life? 2. 2. What do we use to measure length in real life?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. discuss and identify the millimetre as a unit of measuring length using a ruler,

2. measure length of objects in millimetres using a ruler,

3. measure a given length in cm and mm to establish the relationship between mm and cm,

4. convert mm to cm and cm to mm

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. discuss and identify the millimetre as a unit of measuring length using a ruler,
2. measure length of objects in millimetres using a ruler,
3. measure a given length in cm and mm to establish the relationship between mm and cm,
4. convert mm to cm and cm to mm

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Length together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
Unity: learner works amicably with peers to determine lengths in centimetres and millimetres in addition, subtraction,

multiplication and division and discuss the answers.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Learner chooses appropriate units for measuring lengths of different objects in the environment as enhanced from Environmental

Education.

Link to other learning areas:

Learner handles objects with care when measuring lengths of different objects in the school compound for play activities in

Creative Arts.
